tiers.turnaround: for the filing by the end of the same business day of a document received by 12:00 noon Eastern Standard Time

evidence.quote: Two hundred dollars ($200.00) for the filing by the end of the same business day of a document received by 12:00 noon Eastern Standard Time

tiers.turnaround: for the filing of a document within 24 hours after receipt, excluding weekends and holidays

evidence.quote: One hundred dollars ($100.00) for the filing of a document within 24 hours after receipt, excluding weekends and holidays

notes: North Carolina states its expedited service as a guarantee rather than an aspiration  -  the Secretary of State 'shall guarantee the expedited filing of a document upon receipt of the document in proper form and the payment of the required filing fee'  -  and satisfies the request either by filing the document or by notifying the filer that it was rejected. That matters for what the fee buys: it purchases a decision within the window, not an acceptance. The fee is charged per document and there are no refunds of the expedited fee once the document has been processed.
